text:
sara-cs: dropped a sheet with ~30 short soundbites from onboarding calls this morning — can folks skim and add a quick tag (pain / feature / docs) + urgency? link: https://tiny.example/redwood-onboard-snippets :wave:
tyler-prod: just opened — nice format. small ask: add a column for 'renewal-risk' (low/med/high) so we can surface at handoff to AMs.@ana-pm can you add rules for what counts as high?
ana-pm: high = explicit renewal mention + blockers to go-live (e.g., can't verify invoices, integrations failing). low = ask/planned feature. will add a helper column.
mike-ux: skimmed a few. recurring theme: customers confused by 'per-route' billing UI. sample: "I thought this was per-seat, not per-route" — tag: docs + UX.
evan-se: saw a technical cluster: iframe embed latency and token mismatch errors during scale tests. tag: product + infra. added repro note on row 12.
sara-cs: thanks all — quick triage suggestion: anything high renewal-risk gets a ticket with @ana-pm and @tyler-prod assigned within 48h. medium goes to weekly product triage. low gets queued into backlog grooming.
tyler-prod: +1. also flag any "workaround" entries where CS had to do manual steps — those have outsized ops cost.
cs-bot: New NPS feedback uploaded by sara-cs, 30 items.
mike-ux: for prioritization, can we batch similar phrasing? e.g., 8 items about "billing surprises" -> single ticket with examples. reduces noise.
sara-cs: yep grouped those into a 'billing-surprises' cluster (rows 3-10) and added short quotes for context.
nano-pm: typo — my handle is ana-pm :) also, tagging complete. will create EPIC for billing-surprises and propose owners.
ev an-se: assigning myself to investigate embed latency patterns next week, will post findings in this thread.
mike-ux: I'll draft a short UX microcopy proposal for the billing page, share by EOD Fri.
tyler-prod: can someone mark top 5 by business impact? sara, maybe you + AMs do that and ping here.
sara-cs: will sync with AMs now, ping back with top5 by 1729087800.
tyler-prod: perfect — once we have top5 I'll spin up tickets and assign SLAs. thx team :thumbsup:
